mechanism: Sodium valproate inhibits CYP2C9 and may increase tamoxifen metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing tamoxifen active metabolite formation; additionally, both drugs carry teratogenic risk and valproate may increase bleeding through platelet dysfunction.
action: Monitor tamoxifen efficacy closely; consider alternative anticonvulsant if possible; use reliable contraception; monitor for increased bleeding risk and ensure adequate anticonvulsant seizure control.
